agape.title: Bringing AI into Agapé
agape.summary: An audit of AI use across 9 departments and an LLM-based online reputation monitoring tool put into service.
agape.context: Agapé's management wanted to know where AI could help its teams, and to try out concrete tools.
actions: Audit of 9 departments against a 16-criteria grid, with costed recommendations handed to general management (estimated return of 6.5 times the cost for the main recommendation)
Online reputation monitoring tool in React and TypeScript: the Tavily API gathers more than 30 sources per run, then a Claude model (Anthropic API) sorts them. Put into service during the assignment.
Feasibility study and prototype of a Node.js middleware connecting Shopify, the ERP and Brevo, across 3 synchronisation flows
Python script for batch anonymisation of supplier PDF sheets
Handover note covering all 4 projects at the end of the assignment
agape.outcome: One tool in service, costed recommendations handed to management and a documented handover.
agape.next: The middleware stayed at prototype stage: it was not deployed to production.

preity-india.title: Preity India, restaurant website with booking and ordering
preity-india.summary: Live website for an Indian restaurant in Marseille: menu, table booking and takeaway orders.
preity-india.context: Preity India is an Indian restaurant near the Vieux-Port in Marseille. The site presents the menu and lets customers book a table or order takeaway.
preity-india.role: Co-developer with Dinesh Radjou, working directly with the client
actions: Online menu and a showcase of the house specialities
Table booking, including for groups
Click & collect takeaway orders, with customer accounts
Legal pages: terms of use, privacy, cookies, booking and click & collect conditions
preity-india.outcome: The site is live at preityindia.fr.

relations-internationales.title: International mobility management platform
relations-internationales.summary: A PHP/MySQL web application that handles a university institute's international mobility applications, from wish lists to ranking.
relations-internationales.context: Second-year project of my computer science degree (BUT) at the Aix-Marseille institute of technology (IUT), for its international relations office.
relations-internationales.role: Lead developer, product owner and project manager, in a Scrum team of 5
actions: MVC architecture with a service layer and isolated use cases (Clean Architecture)
Authentication with four access levels: visitor, student, administrator and super-administrator
Applicant ranking algorithm, centralised in one service so the formula changes in a single place
Scraper that authenticates against the university's single sign-on (CAS) and syncs the list of destinations
Account anonymisation for GDPR compliance
195 PHPUnit tests, unit and integration, PHPStan static analysis, PSR-12 standard and GitHub Actions continuous integration
relations-internationales.outcome: A complete, tested application designed for more than 1,000 students.
relations-internationales.next: It is not used in production yet. The code is private: demo on request.

pathside.title: PathSide, outdoor spots along your route
pathside.summary: A tool that finds summits, viewpoints, waterfalls, lakes and trails around a route, using OpenStreetMap data.
pathside.context: Hiking apps show hikes, and navigation apps get you from A to B. Nothing connects the two: you drive past great places without knowing it.
actions: Queries the Overpass API for five types of spots in a single request
Handles all three OpenStreetMap object types: nodes, ways and relations
True distance to linear objects: the script walks a trail's full geometry instead of stopping at its centre (Haversine formula)
Retries with exponential backoff, telling transient failures from permanent ones
JSON export ready to feed a map
pathside.outcome: Phase 1, data collection around a point, is complete.
pathside.next: Phase 2 in progress: A→B route calculation, filtering by detour and display on a Leaflet map.

superbomberman.title: SuperBomberman, a JavaFX remake
superbomberman.summary: A playable Bomberman remake in Java, with enemy AI, collisions and chained explosions.
superbomberman.context: First-year team project of my computer science degree (BUT), focused on object-oriented architecture.
actions: SOLID principles and design patterns (Factory, controllers) to keep the code maintainable
Enemy AI, collision handling and chained explosion propagation
Distributed through a jDeploy installer and a demo playable in the browser
superbomberman.outcome: A playable game that can be installed and tried online.
